text_block_list.text:
The new year arrived, and the holidays 
slipped by... 
Memories of last year's triumph, earned 
side by side 
with Blast Onepiece, returned to mind.

...If the Goshiki Shuntaisai is a festival 
shared by horsegirl and human, 
then the horsegirls shouldn't be the only 
ones putting in the effort.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho! An "Umamusume and Sacred Rituals 
Exhibition"?! 
We have stumbled upon an exquisite 
occasion!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, are we all having a study session 
today?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, let's learn all about the rituals 
together!

Yeah, let's learn all about the rituals 
together!

text_block_list.text:
On this day, I visited a museum with the 
shinme 
to broaden our knowledge.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my! Take a look, Maya-chan. 
Hokkaido seems to have its own portable 
shrine procession under a different name!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's true! The shrine design is 
totally different too. 
The wheels are giiiant!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha☆ 
Let's check out the other exhibits too!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...The Soma Nomaoi really has 
existed for over a thousand years.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha~♪ The sheer weight of its history 
is peerless among all Umamusume rituals!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
How about it, Lady Scarlet? 
Fancy switching over from the Yabusame 
faction?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
What kind of offer is that...? 
Yabusame has plenty of history behind it 
too, you know!
choice_data_list:
You two sure know a lot about your own 
rituals.

You two sure know a lot about your own 
rituals.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Eheheh! Well, if we're talking about that, 
Boo's Soaring Gallop might actually be the 
oldest of all!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Right, right?! Totally shocking, huh! 
Boo was super surprised to find the 
historical records too! 
Over this way!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Whoa-hoh?! 
Just which historical era does this hail 
from?!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, looks super ancient, right? 
But the obstacles look just like the ones 
we use now!
choice_data_list:
So this is what ancient Soaring Gallop 
looked like...!

text_block_list.text:
Gazing upon the stone mural, 
the days I spent training with Blast 
Onepiece 
came flooding back.

That summer, helping her craft the routine 
for Soaring Gallop. 
That day when I realized once more that 
the Goshiki Shuntaisai 
is a celebration uniting Umamusume and 
humans.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: —Um.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Is this really Soaring Gallop?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
What is this, Lady Scarlet? 
A desperate plea that your Yabusame must 
be older?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
No, it's not that! 
I mean, look... Isn't Soaring Gallop—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: supposed to require humans?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: —Oh.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Where are the humans...?

I scanned every inch of the mural. 
Yet nowhere in the depiction—
choice_data_list: ...was there a single human to be found.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Yet humans are essential to Soaring 
Gallop, are they not? 
Is that not so, Lady Blast?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah! Without Trainer, 
Boo's Soaring Gallop never would've been 
complete!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Besides, the Goshiki Shuntaisai is a 
festival 
celebrating the bond between Umamusume and 
humans, right? 
So...

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
...M-Maybe Boo just made a mistake! 
Maybe this isn't Soaring Gallop after all!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Look, the description plaque only says 
'Ancient Umamusume Sacred Ritual'! 
Even if it looks a lot like Soaring 
Gallop...

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Even if it looks... really similar... 
.........

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
No! It can't be! 
Soaring Gallop is a sacred ritual between 
Umamusume and humans!!

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
The name of an ancient ritual resembling 
Soaring Gallop, you say?
choice_data_list: Do you know anything about it, Azuma-san?

text_block_list.text:
Right after parting ways with the girls, 
I headed straight to Azuma-san.

After that, asking the museum curator 
and even checking with the chairman of the 
Soaring Gallop Preservation Society 
yielded no answers about the mural's true 
identity.

If so, then just as Blast Onepiece 
insisted, 
perhaps it really depicted a completely 
different ritual. 
If that were the case—

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
...That depicts the ancient form of 
Soaring Gallop.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
my lord. 
This way, please.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Originally, Umamusume utilized their 
superior physical prowess 
to gather and hunt for their sustenance.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Parting the dense brush, bounding over 
deep waters... 
Throughout their history, Umamusume were 
required 
to possess the strength to overcome 
obstacles from ancient times.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Thus, praying that their young would grow 
capable of overcoming any hurdle, 
the sacred ritual of 'Soaring Gallop' was 
born.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
This was back before Umamusume and humans 
had ever crossed paths... 
A tale from distant, ancient antiquity.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text: ...my lord?
choice_data_list:
Ah... No. So that really was Soaring 
Gallop...

text_block_list.text:
The revealed truth struck like a heavy 
blow. 
...A cruel conclusion flashed across my 
mind.

I understood Blast Onepiece's feelings at 
the museum all too well. 
...I wanted to tell her it wasn't true. 
But—

In the original Soaring Gallop, 
were humans completely unnecessary after 
all?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
...Is something the matter, 
my lord?

The Goshiki Shuntaisai is a festival 
honoring the bond between Umamusume and 
humans. 
...Feeling this way felt like a betrayal 
to everyone pouring their hearts into it.

Yet, if the ritual could stand on its own 
solely through Umamusume, with no humans 
required...

Those days of learning from one another 
with Blast Onepiece... 
No, beyond even that—

—In rituals of Umamusume, is the presence 
of 'humans' 
truly necessary at all?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! 
You're back!
choice_data_list: Huh, Blast? What are you doing here...?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Everyone told Boo you went 
to go ask Azuma-san some questions.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
And so, y'know! Listen! 
............Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
That ritual at the museum really is 
different from Soaring Gallop after all, 
right?! 
There's no way humans aren't needed, 
right?!

An ambiguous smile plastered itself across 
my face.

Yet any further answer... 
To deny with my own words the days we 
worked together... 
—I simply couldn't bring myself to do it.
